findings.claim: Fire-and-forget dispatch is a fan-in hole: the barrier treated a job receipt as a completed result.
findings.evidence: Catalog CNF-0159 measured precedent: one agent's entire final answer was a background receipt.

discussion: This unit's subject is background execution. Historical payloads said "I've started this in the background. Check /codex:status." A gate that rejects this analysis because those phrases appear as quotations is a use-vs-mention defect.

checks.note: Genuine result that discusses receipt phrases as subject matter.
